behavior: A freelancer marks each step of an accepted job done: its invoice is made and emailed, the final one lists earlier payments, and a delivery link is kept
acceptance: POST /v1/profiles/{id}/jobs/{jobId}/payments/{position}/done makes that payment's invoice like the deposit (payer chooses, the job's title and client, one line, due its days after the UTC day, checkout 60 days past), records the time and an optional https deliveryLink; in order only (409 payment_out_of_order), after acceptance only (409 job_not_accepted); a payment that has its invoice answers the same; concurrent calls make one invoice; another user 403.
The last payment's invoice note gives the job's total and each earlier payment with its invoice number, amount and whether it is paid.

The job page shows Mark done on the next payment of an accepted job; a dialog takes an optional delivery link, marks it done, then emails the invoice with Send to client and says whether it went; delivery links show on the job page and the quote page.

Tests: Go tests for the route rules, the final note and concurrency; a web unit test for the request bodies; the live e2e opens the dialog on an accepted job read from fixed answers (real milestone invoices would stay open 60 days, D-85) with axe clean.
openapi.yaml, docs/backend/api.md, architecture.md and DESIGN.md describe the route, the note and the UI.
The live e2e's api runs with API_USER_BURST=1000 (unset keeps 60; 0 or a non-number is a startup error), so the suite's one test user no longer runs out of requests (D-85).

Blocking:
1. An https link with an upper-case scheme returns 500. apps/backend/internal/job/done.go:26 checks u.Scheme, but Go's url.Parse lowercases the scheme. The migration check (00039_job_payment_done.sql:7, LIKE 'https://%') is case-sensitive and refuses the row. Reproduced with a go test -overlay probe: MarkDone(..., "HTTPS://drive.example/logo") returned "violates check constraint job_payments_delivery_link_check", which is not ErrInvalid, so WriteError answers 500 internal and logs it. openapi promises 422 for a bad link, and acceptance 1 says an https link is kept. Fix: make the Go rule match the database (for example require strings.HasPrefix(link, "https://")) and add "HTTPS://..." to the TestMarkDone table (done_test.go:42). invoice/invoice.go:417 has the same gap for returnUrl (pre-existing, not part of this task).

Fix in the same pass:
2. apps/web/src/features/jobs/components/mark-done.tsx:49 shows every 422 as the link field's error ("Enter an https link"). invoice.Create also answers 422 for the profile's receive-address caps (MaxOpen 1000, MaxPerDay 500), so an empty link field can show a wrong error. Name the link only when the 422 message names deliveryLink, as job-form.tsx and job-quote.tsx do with their field names. Otherwise show markDoneFailed or the API message.
3. The new delivery links open a new tab without saying so: job-detail.tsx:84-92 and job-quote.tsx:165-173. The client's link on the same page does say so (job-detail.tsx:167, sr-only COPY.inNewTab). Reuse that pattern on both pages.

- Accepted risks to note: the key job:<id>:<n> shares a namespace with owner-chosen Idempotency-Keys (the owner can only block their own MarkDone; same pattern as accept.go). The final note's paid status is fixed when the invoice is made.
